_doc: canopy-web fleet-workspace identity for ACE (read by `canopy agent-publish` / `canopy agent ...`). Workspace integration is best-effort and config-gated — its absence never blocks a turn; nothing here prejudges the ace-web vs canopy-web question (see docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-01-agent-operating-model-adoption.md).
name: ACE
description: AI Connect Engine — runs the full CommCare Connect opportunity lifecycle (design → apps → QA → solicitation → LLO execution → closeout). Flagship agent on the canopy operating model: pipeline runs via /ace:run, counterpart-facing turns via /ace:turn.
_gog_client_doc: The SHARED fleet OAuth client (client_id + client_secret), reused by every agent's mailbox — same value as eva/hal/ada. The per-agent, never-shared identity is `email`: identity bleed means acting as another agent's mailbox, and that is governed by --account, NOT by the client. Do NOT set this to `ace`: no credentials-ace.json is provisioned, so `canopy email` / bin/ace-email fail outright and the printed remedy (`gog login --client ace`) is an interactive browser OAuth a headless turn cannot run. See jjackson/ace#1147.
_gog_services_doc: Services ACE's mailbox must have consented to, checked by `canopy agent doctor`. Mirrors GOG_SERVICES in bin/ace-doctor (the ACE-side preflight) so both halves agree on one list. ACE needs `slides` (ace-gdrive slides_* tools) and `calendar`, neither of which is in canopy's fleet default.
_required_plugins_doc: Plugins a box must install before ACE can run a turn, in the contract runner/ec2/required_plugins.py parses and `canopy agent doctor`'s check_required_plugins reads. Nova is not optional: Phase 3 (commcare-setup) dispatches nova:nova-architect-autonomous via /nova:autobuild, so without it every /ace:run halts at the app build. The 2026-09-05 cloud rebuild reported 'Nova plugin not installed' as a WARN precisely because nothing declared it here.

required_plugins.name: nova
required_plugins.note: Phase 3 app build (/nova:autobuild); needs NOVA_API_KEY from .env

provisioning: .env.tpl + op inject (1Password AI-Agents; see /ace:setup) — no canopy provision manifest
